rules: All values are synthetic known-answer vectors; this manifest grants no physical qualification.
The declared volume uncertainty bound is a conservative additive bound, not an independence-based root-sum-square estimate.
Source substitution credit is capped by both metered recovered outlet delivery and matched end-use demand.
No source substitution is credited without source identity, current meter calibration, matched use/window and qualified declared-use evidence.
Service floors are hard constraints; no energy or cost benefit compensates for a pressure/flow failure.
Leak metrics are event-level arithmetic and do not establish detector field performance.
